text: 50 Health Is Wealth Sub : ENGLISH Notice Grade One Date : 04/11/2025 P - 38 A - 02 T - 40 09/11/2025 - ‘Joyful Saturday’ activity Bring the following ingredients: sprouts, salt, onion, tomato, coriander leaves, boiled potato, cucumber, lemon, chat masala 4. Read and write. Chat Corner Pre-activity Instructions [A day before activity] Activity Time • Take a big bowl. • Add sprouts. • Add chopped vegetables. • Add salt and chat masala. • Mix everything with a spoon. • Add lime juice and mix well. • Enjoy the ‘Sprout Chat’. For the Teacher : • Discuss with children about the importance of eating sprouts and vegetables.
